name: Shahi Shipping Limited
about: Shahi Shipping Limited transports bulk cargo and containers in India. The company provides services in the areas of container liquid cargo lighterage operations for petroleum and chemical products; lighterage operations of bulk cargo; and the container feeder business, as well as supplying bunkers to vessels. It also provides tug services for port-related activities and designs low-draft vessels for operation on Indian coasts. The company owns and operates eight vessels. It was formerly known as SKS Logistics Limited and changed its name to Shahi Shipping Limited in December 2013. Shahi Shipping Limited was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
